posts.name: jorgenp
posts.cooked:
Deadline vs. Captain Cosmic, Mr. Fixer, Omnitron-U and Unity in the Dok'thorath Capital

 

This is a pretty standard Deadline fight with no big surprises.  An fun and easy Mint for me.  I do wonder why the battle to protect humanity is happening on the Thorathian homeworld, but it's still a lot of fun :).

 

There are some nice combos in thsi setup too, especially Omni-U playing Equipment for Unity to make bots (and get exrtra damage to boot).

Mint, ended the game with a fun finisher…
Hasty augmentation on Mr. Fixer with his Crowbar, Monkey Fist, Harmony setup to hit Omnitron-U for 6 (destroying all components for 2 damage each) and then 9 to Deadline for the win.

By the time I won all heroes were in single digits but the game felt fairly safe throughout regardless.

Mint, with a lot of damage coming by way of either Unity or Deadline destroying O-U's stuff. No real trouble here -- leaving the looters out meant that the Rebel Base came out quickly, meaning the next set of rebels were on my side.

posts.name: robb8888
posts.cooked:
Mint, but it was kind of a boring, no-fun slog.  Just about every turn, there was some sort of environment/Deadline effect that did 2-3 damage to *every* target on the board, which wiped out constructs and 'bots almost as soon as I could get them out.  Plus, some of these heroes' best combos/tricks (Salvage Yard, Robot Reclamation, Omni-U's base power, Unflagging Animation) depend on them getting stuff out of their trash, and the %#$@^#%  Severed Ley-Line meant that their trash kept getting recycled into their decks.  

By Round 3-4, I could tell I was going to win by Fixer just relentlessly pounding on Deadline, and the rest of the heroes chipping in little bits whenever they could keep their best bots/constructs/components out for more than a round or two.   Winning isn't much fun when 3/4 of your heroes never really get any of their good combos going.  The thought of the wet "crack/gush" sound as Fixer took Deadline out by burying a crowbar in his skull kinda made up for it, though.
